answer: A hostile operator hence cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The vertex schedule is applied in haven and garden exposes each instalment. A payout is split and thus 39% arrives at settlement and the rest over 10 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 1706 identities would post 3581 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted.
